name: NB Miata - BDC v6 spec (435 bhp)
notes: Recreated from the published BDC v6.0 specs (435 bhp, 504 Nm, 1110 kg). The real car's diff, suspension and tyre data are packed in data.acd, so the setup here is a typical BDC street-tier guess: locked diff, ~62 deg lock, stiff coilovers. Unpack the car in Content Manager and use Garage > Import AC car to get its exact physics. weight_reduction_kg is negative = hardtop, cage and wide body added.
